text:
Annika: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands re: token economics — could someone clarify how credits map to tokens across tiers? Also how bursting works for paid vs free accounts?

Michael (Finance): Short version: 'credit' is our billing unit. Conversion to tokens depends on the model and is expressed as credits per 1k tokens; hosted models have published rates on the pricing page. We'll add a clear per-model table to the docs.

Sam (Product): On bursting: free plans get a small burst buffer to handle spikes; pay-as-you-go customers have larger burst windows tied to recent usage and their credit balance. Reserved/Dedicated is capacity-backed and doesn't rely on burst tokens.

Tao (Eng): Technical detail: our rate limiter is token-based and uses a sliding 60s window plus short-term queue-depth checks. If you exceed the window you'll receive a 429. We also include helpful headers so clients can back off gracefully: `X-Redwood-RateLimit-Limit`, `X-Redwood-RateLimit-Remaining`, `Retry-After`.

Jess (Support): If you hit 429s, use exponential backoff with jitter. Example: `sleep = min(60, base * 2^n) + jitter`. Also surface the `Retry-After` header to users.

Debra (CEO): We want to avoid surprises for customers — Product + Finance will publish a 'token economics' guide with concrete examples (chat vs completion vs embeddings) and a simple calculator in Console.

Samir (Finance): To give a concrete (illustrative) example: a small chat model could be ~0.5 credits / 1k tokens, a large chat model ~2 credits / 1k tokens. Those are examples only; final per-model rates will be published in the table.

Annika: Thanks — one more: do promo credits expire? Folks asked about expiration and rollover.

Michael (Finance): Promo credits expire 12 months after issuance. Credits purchased on an invoice/account balance do not expire. We'll add an FAQ entry and a UI notice on the credits page.

Debra (CEO): Action: Product + Finance to publish the guide and push an in-console calculator by EOD Friday. We'll also update the pricing page and notify customers.

ops-bot: doc-updater: /pricing/token-economics.md pushed to staging :white_check_mark:

Jess (Support): I'll write a short FAQ blurb for support playbooks and the customer-facing help center.

Annika: Tagging @Samir @Tao for implementation follow-ups. :thumbsup:

Tao (Eng): We'll add an `X-Redwood-Quota-Burst` header so customers can monitor burst usage in realtime. ETA for header + docs: ~2 weeks.

Sam (Product): I'll post the doc link here once it's live and drop a short summary for the newsletter.

Annika: Closing thread — thanks everyone for the quick answers and the follow-ups.
